results.title: Indian startup funding fell 72% in H1CY23... - Business Standard
results.body: In all cities, Bangalore emerged as the leader in total funds raised during this period, followed by Delhi-NCR and Mumbai.The funding of Indian startups fell sharply in the first six months of 2023, mainly due to a sharp dip in early-stage rounds, a report released on Thursday said.

results.title: Accel leads $2 mn funding for Swish to expand... - Business Standard
results.body: Swish, a Bangalore-based rapid food-delivery startup, has raised $2 million in seed funding led by Accel, with angel investors including Urban Company founders Abhiraj Bhal and Varun Khaitan, and former Swiggy Instamart head Karthik Gurumurthy.

results.title: Origin starts Bengaluru operations, plans to raise $10 million funding
results.body: Bengaluru-based fresh-tech startup Origin officially launched its operations in the city at a press event today. The firm said it guarantees delivery of over 250 varieties of fruits, vegetables, herbs, and exotic produce within 12 hours of harvest.
